about: Integration rules for chip antennas, read from datasheets and vendor notes. The Antenna tab compares a board with them. Values are the vendor's: they hold for the vendor's own test board and layout, not for every board.

rules.source: vendor datasheet v2.7 (read 2026-11-21): clearance 4.00 x 4.25 mm at the board edge, test board 80 x 37 mm. The C and G variants of this part family have different clearances.

vendor application notes (Ezurio/Laird, Analog Devices AN-1370, Digi, Antenova), search summaries: no copper on any layer of the host board under the antenna's clearance; ground stitching along its edge; a pi match close to the antenna; keep metal structures about 25 mm away. The clearance size comes from the part's own datasheet.
